⚠️ This is a development fork of [TinyGo] to maintain a set
of experimental STM32 related patches,
specifically targeting the STM32G0 and STM32H7 series
(see [stm32/eth] for an example using this branch).

It is the continuation of an [earlier STM32G0-focused approach],
which was started at the end of 2023.

For details please see [issue 1].

[TinyGo]: https://github.com/tinygo-org/tinygo
[stm32/eth]: https://github.com/knieriem/tinygo-exp/tree/main/stm32/eth
[earlier STM32G0-focused approach]: https://github.com/knieriem/tinygo-stm32g0
[issue 1]: https://github.com/knieriem/tinygo/issues/1
